reproducibility_gaps: Stage-3 assessment is static only; no dependency installation, training, inference or evaluation was executed.
Hardware and accelerator requirements for reproducing the documented workflows were not established at the pinned snapshot.
Bundled RVE pickle files are present, but exact generation, transformation and split lineage was not fully reconciled.
Bundled pretrained model artifacts are present, but their run lineage and checksums were not independently verified.
README accuracy and speedup statements were not independently reproduced.
The requirements manifest substantially pins the environment, but cmcrameri and matplotlib are unpinned.
notes: R2 reflects pinned MIT-licensed source, documented Python environment, three identifiable training entrypoints, deterministic seed/default configuration, bundled RVE data, and bundled pretrained artifacts.
R3 is withheld because execution, data/artifact lineage, hardware requirements and the partially unpinned environment remain unresolved.
